name: hud_ui_timer_panel_zar_write_timer_data_callback
description: HudUiTimerPanel::ZarWriteTimerDataCallback writes elapsedSeconds as the 4-byte TimerData blob for the HUD ZAR section.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja still renders the stack float payload as an allocation/decompiler artifact, so tier S comparison is deferred to a HUD timer panel source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40fb90 validates loading timerPanel->elapsedSeconds at offset 0x2a4, storing it into a 4-byte stack payload, passing size 4 and section token TimerData, and calling zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob with the callback context in ecx.
0x4c0010 zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob is functionally equivalent and tier S under target zutil_zar_write_section_blob.

The native timer-panel ZAR write smoke calls ZarWriteTimerDataCallback through a real zZbdManager callback context and verifies one HUD/TimerData record with a 4-byte float payload matching elapsedSeconds.
